description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, 'login' and 'signup', for user authentication operations by making HTTP POST requests to respective backend endpoints. It imports a configuration value 'apiUrl' for constructing request URLs and handles JSON responses and errors.

methods.name: login(payload)
methods.description: Performs user login by sending credentials to the backend '/login' endpoint and returns user data or throws an error on failure.

methods.name: signup(payload)
methods.description: Performs user signup by sending registration data to the backend '/signup' endpoint and returns user data or throws an error on failure.
